reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors AI coding-agent lifecycle events and notifies users through browser toasts, OS notifications, and optional sound.

summaries.zh: 用于监控 DeepSeek Harness 中 AI 编程代理的任务生命周期，并通过页面提示、桌面通知和可选声音提醒用户。
summaries.en: Monitors AI coding-agent lifecycle events in DeepSeek Harness and alerts users with in-page toasts, desktop notifications, and optional sound.

capabilities: Detects AI coding-agent turn, background-job, review, and failure lifecycle events
Requests browser permission for OS-level notifications
Optionally plays a short notification sound
Stores user settings locally in browser localStorage
